policy.scope: Scientific products, diagnostic tables/cubes, and explicitly required operational state products are classified here. Run indexes, logs, merged configuration, and provenance sidecars remain governed by the reduction audit and validation profile.
policy.optional_diagnostic_failure: must be reported and must not masquerade as a complete enabled product
policy.evolution: Contracts are immutable within a validation epoch. An intentional product or scientific-schema change requires a successor contract and validation profile.

apt-prod-001-canonical-baseline-apt-v1.downstream_state: no production ingestion or validation-profile activation
apt-prod-001-canonical-baseline-apt-v1.cal_closure: not claimed; APT binding is separate from CAL physical-science closure

apt-prod-001-canonical-baseline-apt-v1.raw_relation: one unique toltecN input per network N in 0..12 with positive channel_count; rows are a complete bijection over every (network, channel) pair
apt-prod-001-canonical-baseline-apt-v1.occurrence_contract: opaque issuer-provided publication occurrence, distinct from semantic content and not derived from content, path, or time

apt-prod-002-observation-target-manifest.local_key_contract: opaque target-artifact-local row key; unique within one target occurrence and never persistent detector identity
apt-prod-002-observation-target-manifest.raw_relation_contract: one authoritative raw/KMP source binding per represented network with a complete bijection over every selected (network, interface, channel) target row; the raw header must equal the target observation, while the exact KMP header remains immutable fallback/source provenance and may differ without tune-identity reconstruction

field_authorization_registry.unknown_source_diagnostics: permitted in the immutable KMP source and not individually promoted, framed, output, typed, or granted authority; the complete source bytes remain transitively semantic-integrity-bound by the canonical KMP content_sha256 and byte_count
field_authorization_registry.policy: exactly the three required model fields plus optional artifact-level kids_flag; no generic payload, diagnostic bag, design field, Beammap field, or issuer-selected authority is admitted

typed_scalar_encoding.int64: canonical decimal string in signed 64-bit range
typed_scalar_encoding.uint64: canonical decimal string in unsigned 64-bit range
typed_scalar_encoding.float64: exact lowercase 16-hex IEEE-754 binary64 bits; every NaN canonicalized to 7ff8000000000000
typed_scalar_encoding.utf8: canonical single-line UTF-8 with labelled byte length

apt-prod-002-observation-target-manifest.authority_contract: Citlali owns schema, encoding, and validation; TolProj supplies actual selected observation/KMP/raw/network/channel values and source provenance only
apt-prod-002-observation-target-manifest.source_diagnostic_boundary: unknown KMP diagnostic columns may remain in the immutable bound source and its content hash, but no unknown column can be requested as identity, matching evidence, transformation input, output, or authority and none is serialized in the canonical target
apt-prod-002-observation-target-manifest.publication_state: embedded complete logical record only inside the final matched observation APT; no independent suffix, transport, receipt, publication, profile, accepted-run, or ingestion activation

apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.occurrence_contract: opaque issuer-provided artifact occurrence; distinct from content and all parent occurrences
apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.local_key_contract: one global relation-artifact-local key namespace covers every pair and every target/seed disposition record; all keys are unique across all three collections, disposition keys remain present for unmatched/unused records while pair endpoints remain absent, and no key is detector identity
apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.coverage_contract: every target is exactly matched or unmatched and every baseline seed member is exactly matched or unused; every pair is reciprocally named by both endpoint dispositions; unmatched/unused dispositions have no fabricated pair endpoint
apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.cardinality_contract: pair-key sets support 1-to-0, 1-to-1, 1-to-many, and many-to-1 without imposing matcher policy
apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.authority_contract: Citlali owns schema, encoding, and validation; TolProj supplies selected pairs, dispositions, matcher evidence, and observation-specific provenance without transferring matcher policy
apt-prod-002-match-dispositions-v1.publication_state: embedded complete logical record only inside the final matched observation APT; no independent suffix, transport, receipt, publication, profile, accepted-run, or ingestion activation

field_operation_authorization_registry.target_catalog_derivation: preserve every exact target registered field and its immutable raw source_column under preserve-target; kids_flag is optional at target artifact level and reserved against any baseline field of the same name
field_operation_authorization_registry.baseline_catalog_derivation: every verified baseline registered field except all reserved target names; copy exact name/datatype/unit/nonfinite/authority/authority_reference/description, set source_column null and output registry, widen nullable true, and authorize copy-baseline-when-matched-null-when-unmatched

apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.occurrence_contract: opaque Citlali-issued matched-output occurrence; new and distinct from baseline, target, relation, content, path, time, uid, and table order; the caller cannot assert or derive it
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.local_key_contract: opaque output-artifact-local row key; unique within one output occurrence and never persistent detector identity
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.relation_contract: one output row per target; relation_pair_keys are the complete pair set for that target, every target field preserves the exact bound KMP value/source row, and every baseline-sourced transformation names one exact source pair and seed row
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.kids_flag_collision_contract: target kids_flag, when declared, is preserved from its bound KMP report; baseline optional kids_flag is always excluded from the derived baseline catalog and can never overwrite or supply the target field
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.issuer_declared_contract: forbidden for structural/raw fields and unauthorized for every v1 field; a future use requires a successor immutable Citlali field authorization plus datatype, explicit typed before/after values, source authority, and source reference
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.authority_contract: Citlali owns schema, encoding, validation, occurrence and event issuance, software-revision authority, receipt, and publication; TolProj supplies legitimate observation values, selected relation, transformation provenance, configuration reference, and event time
apt-prod-002-observation-matched-apt-v1.publication_state: bounded machine-callable issuer and no-replace receipt-last publisher authorized; registry remains absent from profiles, accepted runs, ingestion, and production activation

map_axis_units: arcsec for AltAz offset maps; deg for equatorial maps
arcsec for AltAz offset maps; deg for equatorial maps
global_conventions.map_indexing: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based in headers; in-memory and diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based unless a product explicitly states otherwise.
global_conventions.polarimetry: Only Stokes I is validated. Enabled polarimetry is a planned-unavailable capability and is rejected before execution.
global_conventions.nonfinite_policy: Historical accepted contracts retain their recorded coverage/weight conventions. In SCI-MAP-001 successor contracts, only science_valid_I is authoritative raw science validity; finite values, weight, exposure, support planes, and compatibility aliases cannot promote a raw-invalid pixel. Fit tables use flag/convergence fields to identify invalid fit values.

known_contract_debt.fact: Several diagnostic variables do not carry complete NetCDF units attributes.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Preserve the current schema during this refactor. Add complete versioned units only as an intentional successor product change.

known_contract_debt.fact: Legacy pointing/Beammap table units are recorded in table metadata rather than Astropy column unit fields; this debt does not describe canonical baseline APT v1.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Treat legacy metadata as the historical authority. Canonical baseline APT v1 is a separate unactivated artifact contract with typed Astropy column units; do not rewrite historical profiles.

known_contract_debt.fact: Many variables have no explicit _FillValue or missing_value attribute.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Current flags and finite-value conventions remain authoritative. Standardized sentinels require a successor schema.

known_contract_debt.fact: Phase-4 v1 products used sig2noise extension names for standardized amplitudes or descriptive ratios. Current writers retain those compatible physical names with explicit canonical product identity metadata; none is calibrated statistical significance.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Keep accepted historical artifacts immutable. Current empirical-product writers store one compatible physical plane per established writer slot and carry canonical SCI-NOI identity in metadata; candidate-added canonical duplicate planes are forbidden. Products without empirical noise emit formal_standardized_signal.

planes.name: geometric_hits_I
planes.logical_fact: Finite in-bounds sample/detector projections before upstream eligibility and mapmaker contribution selection.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable for JINC and detector-grouped products in v1; never inferred from exposure or coefficients.

planes.name: contributing_hits_I
planes.logical_fact: Terms admitted to numerator and denominator by the named estimator contribution predicate.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable for JINC pending SCI-MAP-002 approval of a signed contribution predicate, and unavailable for detector grouping.

planes.name: coadd_observation_count_I
planes.logical_fact: Admitted observation maps contributing to each coadd pixel.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive array-grouped coadd maps only.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly not applicable to observation maps and unavailable for JINC or detector grouping in v1.

planes.name: upstream_eligible_exposure_I
planes.logical_fact: Detector-seconds projected from samples eligible under the upstream validity contract before mapmaker contribution and normalization retention.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable for JINC and detector-grouped products in v1; never reconstructed from retained exposure.

planes.name: retained_exposure_I
planes.logical_fact: Detector-seconds retained after contribution and normalization-support decisions using admitted coadd membership and embedding.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable where the method-specific contribution predicate is unavailable, including JINC and detector grouping in v1.

planes.name: normalization_support_I
planes.logical_fact: Boolean authorization for numerical division/population under the named normalization-support algorithm.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable for JINC and detector-grouped products in v1; it never authorizes science use.

planes.name: science_policy_support_I
planes.logical_fact: Boolean result of the separately versioned full-cut science-support threshold policy.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable for JINC and detector-grouped products in v1; it is not validity by itself.

planes.name: science_valid_I
planes.logical_fact: Authoritative raw science validity: normalization support, science-policy support, finite signal and declared companions, and admitted identity.
planes.applicability: Ordinary naive observation and coadd array-grouped maps in this v1 repair contract.
planes.absence_policy: Explicitly unavailable where required inputs or a method-specific contribution predicate are unavailable, including JINC and detector grouping in v1.

coverage_I.meaning: Compatibility alias only; not wall-clock time, inverse variance, support, confidence, or validity.

coverage_bool_I.meaning: Deprecated threshold-diagnostic compatibility alias; never authoritative science validity.

precision_conditions: SCI-PTC-001 establishes the upstream coefficient calibration and independence/covariance assumptions
the declared response and any empirical scale preserve those conditions
coefficient_contract.coadd_precision_status: not established while cross-observation and cross-pixel covariance are unavailable

sci-map-001-f010-v1.validity_formula: normalization_support_I AND science_policy_support_I AND finite signal_I and every declared required companion AND admitted product identity
sci-map-001-f010-v1.required_companion_policy: Realized provenance enumerates required companions; a missing, undeclared, or non-finite required companion makes science_valid_I false or required publication fail according to the versioned failure policy.
sci-map-001-f010-v1.aggregate_failure_policy: A finite floating-point or signed count aggregate that cannot be represented, or a finite projected coordinate outside the representable integer/index domain before rounding and conversion, is rejected before any live map, product, realization, diagnostic, or coadd mutation. Accepted finite-domain operation order and numerical results are unchanged.

physical_fits_persistence.wcs_authority: The binary64 typed/sidecar WCS is the lossless admission and provenance authority.
physical_fits_persistence.exact_wcs_relations: Axis sign, handedness, orientation, and centered integer observation/coadd shape and reference-pixel relations remain exact; fractional shifts, reprojection, interpolation, and implicit recentering are forbidden.
physical_fits_persistence.threshold_authority: The binary64 sidecar decimal/hex value is exact; FITS threshold cards are finite, correctly identified and unit-bearing convenience metadata with exact policy/alias consistency and rtol=1e-12 agreement with the sidecar.

sci-map-001-f010-v1.realization_persistence_policy: When observation realization products and coaddition are both enabled, required observation-owned realization files are serialized in addition to coadd realization files. Ownership, admitted operator, component/shape identity, support/validity, cardinality, provenance, and required-write failure propagation remain distinct and explicit.
sci-map-001-f010-v1.jinc_absence_policy: This v1 repair does not select a JINC signed-contribution predicate. JINC F010 planes are explicitly unavailable rather than inferred or populated by an ordinary q>0 rule.
sci-map-001-f010-v1.detector_grouping_absence_policy: Detector-grouped products explicitly omit the F010 plane bundle and compatibility aliases in this v1 contract.
sci-map-001-f010-v1.non_array_grouping_absence_policy: Network, frequency-group, detector, and unresolved non-array profiles explicitly omit the F010 plane bundle and compatibility aliases in this v1 contract; they retain the established pre-successor arithmetic lane without an F009/F010 claim.

parallel_equivalence_policy.within_scan: Sequential and requested-parallel ordinary detector/sample accumulation are exact because they share one ordered primitive.
parallel_equivalence_policy.scan_farm: Mutex-protected scan commits may arrive in different orders; each binary64 plane is bounded against a long-double sum of per-scan planes by 2*gamma_n*sum(abs(scan_value)), gamma_n=n*epsilon/(1-n*epsilon). Integer fact planes remain exact.

sci-map-001-f010-v1.filtered_raw_parent_carriage: Before a filter mutates map-domain planes, the validated raw F010 authority is frozen as an immutable input. Filtered signal, weight, F010 planes, and compatibility aliases carry RAWSTATE=immutable_input and one identical lossless RAWPDGST value; filtered empirical recalculation cannot rewrite the raw products or digest.
sci-map-001-f010-v1.covariance_policy: No GLS, covariance regularization, coadd uncertainty, inverse-variance, or significance claim is authorized; precision remains conditional on SCI-PTC-001 and named covariance evidence.

science_map_cube_altaz_v1.scientific_identity: SCI-MAP-001 v1 array-grouped raw Stokes-I estimator bundle with nonprecision normalization coefficients and typed hit, exposure, support, validity, response, and alias products when the selected method supports them.
science_map_cube_altaz_v1.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the admitted configured map center; every image plane has identical full WCS cards and shape.
science_map_cube_altaz_v1.units_policy: Per-HDU BUNIT, ESTTYPE, DATTYP, and validity/alias metadata are authoritative. weight_I is a nonprecision normalization coefficient by default; count, detector-second, and binary-mask planes use their frozen F010 units.
science_map_cube_altaz_v1.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; in-memory and diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
science_map_cube_altaz_v1.missing_value_policy: Only science_valid_I is authoritative raw science validity. Explicitly unavailable method/grouping facts are absent and explained in realized provenance; unsupported pixels cannot be promoted by finite values, coefficients, exposure, or compatibility aliases.
science_map_cube_altaz_v1.failure_policy: Required ordinary-naive array-grouped bundle or metadata failure is fatal; unavailable JINC or non-array-grouping facts must be explicit and may not be synthesized.

science_map_cube_celestial_v1.scientific_identity: SCI-MAP-001 v1 array-grouped raw Stokes-I estimator bundle with nonprecision normalization coefficients and typed hit, exposure, support, validity, response, and alias products when the selected method supports them.
science_map_cube_celestial_v1.coordinate_frame: Equatorial J2000 TAN projection centered on the admitted science field; every image plane has identical full WCS cards and shape.
science_map_cube_celestial_v1.units_policy: Per-HDU BUNIT, ESTTYPE, DATTYP, and validity/alias metadata are authoritative. weight_I is a nonprecision normalization coefficient by default; count, detector-second, and binary-mask planes use their frozen F010 units.
science_map_cube_celestial_v1.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; in-memory and diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
science_map_cube_celestial_v1.missing_value_policy: Only science_valid_I is authoritative raw science validity. Explicitly unavailable method/grouping facts are absent and explained in realized provenance; unsupported pixels cannot be promoted by finite values, coefficients, exposure, or compatibility aliases.
science_map_cube_celestial_v1.failure_policy: Required ordinary-naive array-grouped bundle or metadata failure is fatal; unavailable JINC or non-array-grouping facts must be explicit and may not be synthesized.

science_map_filtered_altaz_v1.scientific_identity: Existing filtered AltAz map products with raw-parent science validity kept separate from operator-local numerical support, response, covariance, and output validity.
science_map_filtered_altaz_v1.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent plane inherited from the admitted raw parent.
science_map_filtered_altaz_v1.units_policy: Signal/kernel and optional empirical products retain their established units. weight_I remains a nonprecision normalization coefficient; no inverse-variance or significance claim is implied.
science_map_filtered_altaz_v1.missing_value_policy: A finite filtered value or local coverage diagnostic cannot promote a raw-invalid pixel. SCI-FLT-001 governs future filtered validity products.
science_map_filtered_altaz_v1.failure_policy: Fatal when filtered output is enabled; this contract does not alter the filter estimator.

science_map_filtered_celestial_v1.scientific_identity: Existing filtered celestial map products with raw-parent science validity kept separate from operator-local numerical support, response, covariance, and output validity.
science_map_filtered_celestial_v1.coordinate_frame: Equatorial J2000 TAN projection inherited from the admitted raw parent.
science_map_filtered_celestial_v1.units_policy: Signal/kernel and optional empirical products retain their established units. weight_I remains a nonprecision normalization coefficient; no inverse-variance or significance claim is implied.
science_map_filtered_celestial_v1.missing_value_policy: A finite filtered value or local coverage diagnostic cannot promote a raw-invalid pixel. SCI-FLT-001 governs future filtered validity products.
science_map_filtered_celestial_v1.failure_policy: Fatal when filtered output is enabled; this contract does not alter the filter estimator.

science_map_detector_group_v1.scientific_identity: Detector-grouped map cube preserving the existing Beammap estimator while explicitly omitting the SCI-MAP-001 F010 plane bundle and aliases.
science_map_detector_group_v1.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the Beammap source.
science_map_detector_group_v1.units_policy: Signal/kernel use map signal units and weight_I is a nonprecision normalization coefficient; F010 count/exposure/mask units are not applicable because those planes are absent.
science_map_detector_group_v1.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixels are one-based; any APT uid association is artifact-local and valid only inside an explicitly bound source-artifact occurrence.
science_map_detector_group_v1.missing_value_policy: The eight F010 planes plus coverage_I and coverage_bool_I are explicitly absent for detector grouping in this v1 contract; no omitted plane may be inferred.
science_map_detector_group_v1.failure_policy: Fatal for required Beammap output; emitting a forbidden F010 or compatibility plane is a contract failure.

map_cube_altaz.scientific_identity: Per-array Stokes-I map planes with signal, nonprecision coefficients, kernel, coverage, and estimator-explicit standardized products. Empirical products are conditional finite-stack diagnostics, never calibrated statistical significance; products without them use explicitly labeled formal-weight-standardized signal.
map_cube_altaz.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the configured map center.
map_cube_altaz.units_policy: BUNIT and ESTTYPE are authoritative per HDU: signal/kernel in mJy/beam, nonprecision coefficients in inverse squared signal units, conditional stack scatter in squared signal units, coverage in seconds, and masks/standardized products dimensionless. Legacy sig2noise names are deprecated aliases and carry explicit not-significance metadata.
map_cube_altaz.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
map_cube_altaz.missing_value_policy: Signal-like pixels may be non-finite where coverage/weight is invalid; coverage_bool identifies supported pixels.
map_cube_altaz.failure_policy: Fatal when the map family is enabled in the active profile.

map_cube_celestial.scientific_identity: Per-array Stokes-I map planes with signal, nonprecision coefficients, kernel, coverage, and estimator-explicit standardized products. Empirical products are conditional finite-stack diagnostics, never calibrated statistical significance; products without them use explicitly labeled formal-weight-standardized signal.
map_cube_celestial.coordinate_frame: Equatorial J2000 TAN projection centered on the configured science field.
map_cube_celestial.units_policy: BUNIT and ESTTYPE are authoritative per HDU: signal/kernel in mJy/beam, nonprecision coefficients in inverse squared signal units, conditional stack scatter in squared signal units, coverage in seconds, and masks/standardized products dimensionless. Legacy sig2noise names are deprecated aliases and carry explicit not-significance metadata.
map_cube_celestial.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
map_cube_celestial.missing_value_policy: Signal-like pixels may be non-finite where coverage/weight is invalid; coverage_bool identifies supported pixels.
map_cube_celestial.failure_policy: Fatal when the map family is enabled in the active profile.

map_histogram.scientific_identity: Per-array histograms of map pixels and, where generated, noise-map pixel populations.
map_histogram.coordinate_frame: Not spatial; values summarize the associated map cube.
map_histogram.units_policy: Inherits the associated map signal scale by variable identity; complete NetCDF unit attributes are known debt.
map_histogram.missing_value_policy: No explicit fill-value contract; validity follows the associated map population.
map_histogram.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

map_psd.scientific_identity: Per-array one- and two-dimensional power spectra for map and noise-map products.
map_psd.coordinate_frame: Spatial-frequency representation of the associated map grid.
map_psd.units_policy: Frequency/value units are implicit in the current variable schema; complete NetCDF unit attributes are known debt.
map_psd.missing_value_policy: No explicit fill-value contract; non-finite values are compared by the numerical product gate.
map_psd.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

map_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Map identity, noise, coverage, edge-guard, coadd, and peak diagnostic scalars.
map_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: References map-grid row/column and the coordinate frame of the associated map.
map_diagnostics.units_policy: Variable names and selected attributes carry current units; complete unit metadata is known debt.
map_diagnostics.indexing_policy: Map peak row/column values are zero-based.
map_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Unavailable diagnostics may be non-finite; integer counts and identity fields must remain present.
map_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

detector_stats.scientific_identity: Detector, array, and chunk statistics plus artifact-local detector-row/calibration columns.
detector_stats.coordinate_frame: Detector and acquisition-chunk domains; fitted detector positions use telescope offsets where present.
detector_stats.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present.
detector_stats.indexing_policy: Zero-based NetCDF array indexing; apt_uid is an artifact-local copied association rather than persistent detector identity.
detector_stats.missing_value_policy: Detector flags determine usability; explicit standardized fill attributes are incomplete known debt.
detector_stats.failure_policy: Fatal when statistics output is enabled in the active profile.

rtc_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Raw-timestream calibration and cleaning diagnostics by scan, detector, array, and network.
rtc_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Telescope/time and detector/network domains; pointing quantities retain their named physical frames.
rtc_diagnostics.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present; N/A denotes dimensionless or categorical fields.
rtc_diagnostics.indexing_policy: output_scan_index is the one-based original scan number; NetCDF dimension positions and array indices are zero-based; detector association is artifact-local and carried separately.
rtc_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Flags and availability variables govern validity; standardized fill attributes are incomplete known debt.
rtc_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when RTC diagnostics are enabled in the active profile.

ptc_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Processed-timestream weights, cleaning, detector, and scan diagnostics.
ptc_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Time/scan and detector/network domains, with named telescope coordinates where emitted.
ptc_diagnostics.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present; N/A denotes dimensionless or categorical fields.
ptc_diagnostics.indexing_policy: output_scan_index is the one-based original scan number; NetCDF dimension positions are zero-based; ptc_diag_uid carries an artifact-local row association only.
ptc_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Detector flags and diagnostic availability govern validity; fill metadata is incomplete known debt.
ptc_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when PTC diagnostics are enabled in the active profile.

rtc_timestream.scientific_identity: Selected calibrated raw-stage detector timestream samples, flags, telescope data, and metadata.
rtc_timestream.coordinate_frame: Time-ordered detector samples with named telescope coordinate streams.
rtc_timestream.units_policy: signal uses the recorded signal unit; flags are dimensionless; telescope variables carry per-variable units.
rtc_timestream.indexing_policy: Samples and detector rows are zero-based; apt_uid carries an artifact-local row association only.
rtc_timestream.missing_value_policy: flags identify invalid samples; padded/outer-context policy is recorded in the file.
rtc_timestream.failure_policy: Fatal when RTC timestream output is enabled.

ptc_timestream.scientific_identity: Selected processed detector timestream samples, flags, weights, telescope data, and metadata.
ptc_timestream.coordinate_frame: Time-ordered detector samples with named telescope coordinate streams.
ptc_timestream.units_policy: signal and weights derive from the recorded signal unit; flags are dimensionless.
ptc_timestream.indexing_policy: Samples and detector rows are zero-based; apt_uid carries an artifact-local row association only.
ptc_timestream.missing_value_policy: flags identify invalid samples; weight validity is explicit.
ptc_timestream.failure_policy: Fatal when PTC timestream output is enabled.

pointing_fit_table.scientific_identity: Per-array pointing-source amplitude, offset, beam-shape, angle, uncertainty, explicitly defined formal-fit significance, and retained legacy peak-over-full-map-RMS dynamic range.
pointing_fit_table.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
pointing_fit_table.indexing_policy: Rows are keyed by array identity, not positional index.
pointing_fit_table.missing_value_policy: Invalid fit values may be non-finite and are interpreted with fit quality and signal-to-noise fields.
pointing_fit_table.failure_policy: Fatal when pointing fitting is enabled.

beammap_detector_cube.scientific_identity: Per-detector signal, weight, and kernel map planes split into accepted and rejected detector groups.
beammap_detector_cube.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the Beammap source.
beammap_detector_cube.units_policy: Signal/kernel use mJy/beam and weights use inverse squared signal units.
beammap_detector_cube.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixels are one-based; det_N is a product position and any linked APT uid remains artifact-local to its bound occurrence.
beammap_detector_cube.missing_value_policy: Invalid pixels may be non-finite; detector-group flags and positive weights determine validity.

beammap_apt_table.scientific_identity: Artifact-local detector rows with calibration, fitted beam, pointing, sensitivity, flag, and KIDs quantities.
beammap_apt_table.coordinate_frame: Detector focal-plane/telescope offsets with raw and derotated variants explicitly named.
beammap_apt_table.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
beammap_apt_table.indexing_policy: uid is an exact artifact-local row key only; it is neither persistent detector identity nor an external detector identifier.
beammap_apt_table.missing_value_policy: flag, flag2, convergence, and fit fields govern validity of numerical columns.

beammap_fit_qc.scientific_identity: Per-detector Beammap fit inputs, bounds, priors, convergence, quality, and diagnostic decisions.
beammap_fit_qc.coordinate_frame: Raw, prior, fitted, and derotated telescope-offset quantities are explicitly named.
beammap_fit_qc.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
beammap_fit_qc.indexing_policy: uid is an artifact-local row key only; slot indices are zero-based internal candidate slots.
beammap_fit_qc.missing_value_policy: good_fit, converged, flag, flag2, and no-candidate reason fields govern validity.
beammap_fit_qc.failure_policy: Fatal when Beammap fit-QC output is enabled in the active profile.

beammap_detector_tod.scientific_identity: Bounded per-detector source-crossing processed timestream windows and slot metadata.
beammap_detector_tod.coordinate_frame: Time samples indexed around source crossings with source distance and fitted telescope offsets.
beammap_detector_tod.units_policy: signal uses the PTC signal unit; source distances and fitted offsets use arcsec; flags are dimensionless.
beammap_detector_tod.indexing_policy: Artifact-local detector-row uid is explicit; slot, scan, and sample bounds are zero-based.
beammap_detector_tod.missing_value_policy: detector_tod_n_samples bounds valid samples in each padded slot; flags mark invalid samples.
beammap_detector_tod.failure_policy: Fatal when Beammap detector-TOD output is enabled.

profile_timing.indexing_policy: index is a record identifier; naturally concurrent record order is not a scientific contract.
profile_timing.missing_value_policy: No missing values expected in emitted rows.
profile_timing.failure_policy: Optional operational diagnostic; absence does not invalidate scientific products.

learning_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Bounded learning-policy diagnostic records for the active fruit-loop iteration.
learning_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Depends on the named diagnostic record; not a map product.
learning_diagnostics.units_policy: Column-specific names and values define the current diagnostic schema.
learning_diagnostics.indexing_policy: Iteration in the filename is zero-based.
learning_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Optional record types may be absent by policy.
learning_diagnostics.failure_policy: Optional diagnostic unless explicitly promoted by a future profile.

learning_housekeeping_qa.scientific_identity: Diagnostic-only nearest-housekeeping matches for deduplicated busy-network learning pathologies.
learning_housekeeping_qa.coordinate_frame: Unix time associated with a zero-based observation scan and detector-network identity; not a map product.
learning_housekeeping_qa.units_policy: Temperatures are kelvin; event, sample, offset, and age columns are seconds. Channel identity and match status are explicit.
learning_housekeeping_qa.indexing_policy: Iteration in the filename and scan_zero_based are zero-based. sample_offset_sec is sample time minus event time.
learning_housekeeping_qa.missing_value_policy: The status column distinguishes missing, ambiguous, malformed, unavailable-sentinel, out-of-range, and matched data; numeric fields are empty when unavailable.
learning_housekeeping_qa.failure_policy: Diagnostic input availability never changes flags. Once learning diagnostics are enabled, sidecar output I/O failure is fatal.

reduction_restart_checkpoint.scientific_identity: Atomic operational checkpoint containing absolute fruit-loop iteration identity, observation identity, policy snapshots, compacted learning state, and retained processed-weight validation state needed for exact continuation.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.coordinate_frame: Not spatial; observation, detector, scan, and sample identities retain their named acquisition domains.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.units_policy: Iteration, observation, detector, scan, network, array, and sample indices are dimensionless; detector-penalty event time is Unix seconds; factors and scores are dimensionless.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.indexing_policy: completed_iteration and next_iteration are zero-based absolute fruit-loop indices; observation references index the checkpoint observation_id vector.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.missing_value_policy: Observation identity is required and non-empty. Zero learned masks, penalties, or weight-validation slots are represented by zero count scalars and absent optional state dimensions.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.failure_policy: Fatal when fruit loops are enabled; the checkpoint is written atomically after each completed iteration.
